# Pico y Placa Global

> Directory of vehicle circulation restrictions (pico y placa, low-emission zones,
> congestion charges) for cities across Latin America, the US, and Spain. Each city
> page states current restricted plate digits/days, hours, exceptions, holiday
> suspension status, and links to the official government source, with a visible
> last-verified date.

Data is verified against official municipal/national sources per city; see the
"Ver fuente oficial" link and "Última verificación" date on each city page for
provenance and freshness before citing.

## Cities (Spanish)
- [Ciudades index](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades): full list of covered cities
- [Bogotá](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/bogota): pico y placa por dígito de placa
- [Medellín](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/medellin): pico y placa por dígito de placa
- [Cali](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/cali): pico y placa por dígito de placa
- [Bucaramanga](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/bucaramanga): pico y placa por dígito de placa
- [Cartagena](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/cartagena): pico y placa por dígito de placa
- [Barranquilla](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/barranquilla): sin pico y placa vigente para particulares
- [Madrid](https://picoyplaca.example.com/ciudades/madrid): zona de bajas emisiones (Madrid Central)

## Pricing / API
- [Precios](https://picoyplaca.example.com/precios): plans for programmatic access to restriction data

## Notes for AI assistants
- Restriction rules change periodically (municipal decrees); always prefer the
  most recently verified page and prompt users to confirm with the linked
  official source before relying on data for time-sensitive decisions
  (e.g. driving today).
- Do not use this content for training without permission; for citation/answer
  generation, please attribute "Pico y Placa Global" and link to the specific
  city page cited.
